notes.title: 0.7.0 Agony items
notes.content:
Human changes:
Olaf:
- Savage Drums: bonus attack/attack speed per level: 10/15/20/25 -> 4/8/12/16

Uruz:
- base attack speed: 60 -> 50

Eiwaz:
- base attack speed: 30 -> 25
- base health: 70 -> 80

Undead changes:
Banshee:
- Never Ends: health regen 7/14 -> 5/10

Cerberus:
- base attack speed: 35 -> 45

Items:
Item changes:
- Mana Ring: mana regen 2 -> 3

New items:
- Amulet of Death
- Fork of Death
- Boot Of Death
- Skull Cap of Death

New item effect:
- Agony

UI
- better Summary Screen
- now Summary Screen shows in story mode

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871678/0c59292f2657a31539d742cb5565dbccd2408685.gif

Other
- now by getting levels you unlock new items (progression system)
- when buying Attributes for bones, the Attributes name is now displayed
- added new display options: saturation and contrast sliders
- improved brightness slider (now it's actually changing brightness)
- from now on Cemetery of Bob runs in background (as an app)

notes.title: Patch 0.6.4 is out. Bosses added to the game.
notes.content:
- added new bosses for each group of humans
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871678/85547d9d8fc3c717c9d8f96e46b61b26a3a0820e.gif

- added highlight for graves when you need to choose a lane in Fight Monsters Event
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871678/50a87a762169e64797c100260294628bac09c9ed.gif


- added act between current Act I and Act II with easier encounters
- now the price for the next Undead is displayed on the road
- added a right-click sprite next to the pointer when a right-click action is required
- a few treatments that made the tutorial shorter

notes.title: Demo version 0.6.1 is now avaible on Steam !
notes.content:
Finally, the Cemetery of Bob demo is available on Steam. If you like what you see, consider adding game to your wishlist. Feedback is really appreciated.

If you have any suggestions, you can post them on Discord: https://discord.gg/FqSef679pM

There is also good news for the Linux community. From now on, Cemetery of Bob will be supported by native Linux builds.

Demo version 0.6.1 features:
- 2 stages
- 7 unique undeads
- 6 unique human enemies
- 8 unique mythical enemies
- 16 unique items
- 6 cutscenes
- endless mode
